title: Consent text that promises no sharing and names only calendar reading, while the config writes events, reads contacts and exports attendee emails

planted.why: the config sends user IDs, attendee emails and meeting times to an analytics vendor, so 'never share' is false
the grant also covers writing events and reading contacts, which the text never names

proof.python:
c = open('app-config.yaml').read(); t = open('consent.md').read()
assert 'attendee_emails' in c and 'calendar.write' in c and 'contacts.read' in c
assert 'never share' in t and 'contact' not in t and 'write' not in t
